title: Bulgogi (Korean beef) with rice and cucumber
steps: Finely grate the pear, garlic and ginger and stir with the soy sauce, sugar and 1 tsp sesame oil into a marinade.
Slice the beef very thinly and marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Wash the rice and cook it with 170 ml water for 12 minutes; slice the cucumber and mix it with rice vinegar.
Cut the onion and carrot into strips and fry in the remaining sesame oil for 3 minutes, add the beef and stir-fry over high heat for 3–4 minutes.
Sprinkle with spring onions and sesame and serve with rice and cucumber.
